audit_summary: All ten facts are directly supported by the cited repository files.

facts.statement: The Python file collection hook exempts initial command-line paths from pattern filtering; for other .py files it matches against configured python_files plus an unconditional "__init__.py" pattern.
Every __init__.py accepted by the Python collection hook is represented as a Package collector rather than a regular Module collector.

When a directory is supplied for collection, Session recursively visits all files, constructs an __init__.py path for each newly encountered directory, and submits every existing such file to _collectfile before considering ordinary files in that directory.
The directory traversal filter admits every filesystem file; filename-pattern eligibility is deferred to collection hooks.
Module object loading calls py.path.local.pyimport, so collecting a Package causes its __init__.py module code to be imported and executed.
Package inherits from Module, and Package does not override Module._getobj; Module._getobj imports the test module through _importtestmodule.

Package collection separately includes its own __init__.py as a Module only when that file matches configured python_files, showing that collecting an initializer's tests is intended to remain configuration-dependent even though creation/import of the Package collector is currently unconditional.

The existing initializer-test regression test documents that tests inside __init__.py are collected when python_files is configured to match them, and verifies explicit directory and initializer-file collection cases.
Another existing test explicitly states that __init__.py is not collected when it does not match python_files.
Existing direct-argument tests expect a package initializer supplied alone to yield no tests under default python_files, but to collect its test when python_files is overridden to *.py.

scope_summary: Base commit e856638ba086fcf5bebf1bebea32d5cf78de87b4 contains a collection path that treats every encountered __init__.py as eligible independently of the configured python_files patterns, creates Package collectors for those files, and imports them during collection.
